mandatoryCriteria: Owner invitation authority: Workspace owner can invite manager, member, and viewer roles to any project within their workspace via POST /api/v1/projects/:projectId/invitations
Project Manager authority limit: Project Manager can invite member and viewer roles only; attempting to invite a manager returns 403 FORBIDDEN
Role boundary enforcement: Project members and viewers cannot invite; unauthorized attempts return 403 FORBIDDEN
Sibling project privacy: Outsiders and non-members attempting to invite to an ungranted project receive 404 NOT_FOUND

Cryptographic token hashing: Single-use invitation token with 256-bit entropy is generated and stored solely as a SHA-256 hash in project_invitations with 7-day expiry; raw token is never persisted or logged
Transactional outbox creation: Invitation creation atomically writes a durable email delivery intent record to the outbox table in the same PostgreSQL transaction
R2 & R5 audit compliance: Rejects invitation attempts for existing active project members and self-invites; Idempotency-Key is enforced with transactional receipt
Validation and error envelopes: Malformed emails, missing roles, or unknown payload attributes fail with standard 400 or 422 error envelopes
scopeAndExclusions: In-scope: POST /api/v1/projects/:projectId/invitations endpoint, role-based authorization guards, SHA-256 token hashing, transactional outbox record insertion, idempotency receipts, and PostgreSQL state checks across Node and Worker. Out-of-scope: Background outbox queue worker execution is handled under INV-02.
